'''2000 Coventry Grand Slam Simon Moore LS''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Simon Moore]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls108.htm Nudj-Revo UK Grand Slam Winner], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010228021352/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls108.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]] (from the card pool)

* '''Event:''' [[2000 Coventry Grand Slam]] (1st)
